name: Description List
description: A label/value definition list for detail pages, stacked or two-column.
usage:
<DescriptionList
  items={[
    { label: 'Owner', value: 'Avery Chen' },
    { label: 'Created', value: 'March 4, 2026' },
  ]}
/>

anatomy.description: The muted label on the left of each row.
The right-aligned value in semibold, paired with its term.
A hairline-separated flex row; the last row drops its border.

dos: Keep labels short and scannable; the value carries the detail.
Order items so the most identifying facts come first.
Switch to layout="grid" on detail pages with more than a handful of rows.
donts: Don't compare several records in one list; use Table for columnar comparison.
Don't fill values with long paragraphs; link out to full content instead.

examples.title: Detail summary
examples.description: Real dl markup; grid layout splits into two columns on wider screens.

examples.title: Two-column grid
examples.description: layout="grid" splits rows into two columns from the small breakpoint up.

guidance.useWhen: A detail view lists labeled values for one entity.
guidance.avoidWhen: Records need column comparison; use Table.
guidance.behavior: Real dl/dt/dd markup keeps the relationship semantic.
guidance.responsive: Stacked layout is default; grid splits to two columns on wider screens.

notes: Renders real dl, dt, and dd markup, so the label-value relationship is announced by screen readers.
Each row pairs exactly one term with one definition inside a wrapper div, which is valid description-list HTML.

props.description: `stacked` fills the container width; `grid` splits rows into two columns on small screens and up.
props.name: layout
